column1: # English glosses for the Armenian word bank (words_hy.txt), shared by the iOS and Android apps.
# Shown after a game and as the "Armenian word of the day" for learners.
# Format: WORD<TAB>gloss, one entry per line. Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored.
# Words without an entry simply show no meaning. Keep entries short (one or two senses).
